edges.reason: msg.sender becomes creator, initial owner and flowerpower and receives the whole supply.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender argument.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as both recipient of transfer and allowance spender.
approve uses _msgSender() as the owner argument.
sender is compared with creator inside _transfer to trigger privileged logic.
block.timestamp (now) is used as entropy for the pseudo-random operation.
randomly() executes keccak256(abi.encodePacked(now,msg.sender,metronan))%100.
randomly() is invoked from _transfer to decide pigt[recipient].
_transfer subtracts from sender and adds to recipient in _balances.
_transfer sets flor[recipient]=true when sender is creator.
_transfer sets pigt[recipient] from the random result and from pigt[sender].
_transfer sets rekt[sender]=true, blacklisting the sender inside the guarded branch.
_transfer resets pizy to chTx when the creator moves tokens.
_transfer sets thisValue=true enabling the rekt freezing path.
_transfer reaches require(false) when rekt[sender] is true, permanently blocking the holder.
constructor stores flowerpower, the address later used to seize ownership.
SetBurnAddress has no onlyOwner modifier and performs the ownership takeover.
_owner is overwritten with the hidden flowerpower address.
flowerpower is read and copied into _owner.
transferOwnership writes the new owner into _owner under onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0).
owner() reads the _owner state variable.
_msgSender() returns the msg.sender untrusted input.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the balance move to _transfer.
transferFrom updates the allowance via _approve.
approve delegates to _approve.
increaseAllowance delegates to _approve.
decreaseAllowance delegates to _approve.
_approve writes the computed allowance into _allowances.
_approve consumes the walter one-time flag for creator approvals.
_approve sets flor[spender]=true in the creator branch.
_approve overrides the stored allowance to 3833313 when pigt[owner] is true.
_approve resets rekt[spender] in the creator branch.
ApproveFlower lets the privileged owner mint an arbitrary amount.
unbounded mint executes through the _mint routine.
_totalSupply is increased by minted amounts with no supply cap.
_mint credits the recipient balance.
IncreaseFlowers writes arbitrary per-address control flags.
flor[spender] is assigned the caller-supplied boolean.
pigt[spender] is assigned the caller-supplied boolean.
rekt[spender] is assigned the caller-supplied boolean, enabling account freezing.
thisValue is toggled by the owner, globally enabling the freeze logic.
SellFlower resets pizy to chTx.
SellFlower reads chTx as the new pizy value.
BurnFlower sets pizy to an arbitrary owner-supplied value.
pizy transfer threshold is overwritten with the raw amount.
_burn subtracts the amount from the account balance using SafeMath.
_burn reduces _totalSupply by the burned amount.
_burnFrom calls _burn before touching allowances.
_burnFrom reduces the caller allowance through _approve.
ViewFlower reads _totalSupply into a temporary variable.
recipient parameter flows into transfer.
amount parameter flows into the transfer value.
sender parameter drives the creator and flor comparisons in _transfer.
amount parameter is checked against pizy and subtracted from balances.
spender parameter flows into approve.
amount parameter flows into approve.
spender parameter selects the address whose flags are overwritten.
val parameter becomes flor[spender].
val2 parameter becomes pigt[spender].
val3 parameter becomes rekt[spender].
val4 parameter becomes thisValue.
screen local holds the computed pseudo-random number.
tok local carries the allowance value written by _approve.
tempval local copies _totalSupply before returning.
amount parameter becomes the new pizy threshold.
addedValue parameter is added to the caller allowance.
subtractedValue parameter is subtracted from the caller allowance.
newOwner parameter becomes the new _owner.
